release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD95C8-190ZK2FL is a thermal & optical bi-spectrum network sphere positioning system (PTZ) pairing a 1280x1024 uncooled VOx thermal module (38 to 190 mm) with a 2 MP 100x optical zoom camera, adding temperature measurement, fire detection, perimeter VCA and a 3000 m laser IR illuminator for airport, port and perimeter surveillance. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and optical exposed as separate channels; thermal is usually Channel 2, optical Channel 1.
